name: weightbench
description: The gym — posture-based workouts on furniture flagged with a station key. Three stations, one loop: `lift` a bench (Brawn), `spar` a rebound wall (Reflexes), `drill` a conditioning circuit (Endurance). Enough sets grant a point, with a rising rep cost per level; the point is paid straight out of Net XP, so reps are the time-gate and XP is the real one. Stations are data in stations.js.
